name: email_record_processed
description: Extracts structured information from an internship/job application status update email.

status.description: The application status represented by this email.

company.description: Normalised company name. Do not include recruiting agencies, email addresses, or legal suffixes unless they are part of the commonly used company name.

company_raw.description: The company name exactly or approximately as it appears in the email.

location.description: Normalised job location (e.g. London, United Kingdom), if given.

deadline.description: Deadline by which the user must take an action. ISO 8601 datetime with timezone where available.

interview_date.description: Scheduled interview datetime in ISO 8601 format, if given.

next_action.description: The action the candidate needs to take next, if any.

notes.description: Other important information that does not fit the structured fields.

confidence.description: Model's estimated confidence in the overall extraction. This is a heuristic confidence score, not a calibrated probability.

evidence.description: Short excerpt or paraphrase identifying the key evidence supporting the extracted status.
